name: Capacitor voltage transformer
summary: An instrument transformer using a capacitive voltage divider and an electromagnetic unit to supply documented voltage measurement or protection signals.
description: A capacitor voltage transformer combines a capacitive divider with an electromagnetic unit to provide voltage signals for its documented metering or protection application. Manufacturer arrangements may also provide interfaces for power-line carrier equipment.

In a single line diagram, identify the high-voltage connection and the measurement or protection circuits served by the secondary outputs. The conceptual preview illustrates the operating arrangement; it is not a certified standard symbol or a manufacturer connection drawing.
readingNotes: Distinguish the capacitive divider and electromagnetic unit from a standalone coupling capacitor.
Trace the secondary circuits and any carrier interface using the selected model documentation rather than assuming they share the same connection.
drawingChecklist: Identify the exact CVT/CCVT equipment tag and the voltage circuit represented.
Reference the specified primary/secondary arrangement, measurement duties and secondary earthing details.
Cross-reference the manufacturer terminal diagram and any documented carrier or damping-system interfaces.
distinction: An inductive voltage transformer and a capacitor voltage transformer can both supply voltage signals, but their operating arrangements and transient behaviour differ. A coupling capacitor alone is not a complete CVT.
